allow_hpa_right_sizing.description: Whether HPA-managed workloads are subject to right-sizing.

allow_restart.description: Whether Komodor may restart pods to apply right-sizing. Effective only when apply_protocol = "onCreation".

apply_protocol.description: When to apply right-sizing changes. One of: `immediate`, `onCreation`. **Note:** `immediate` materializes workload override records for every matching workload as soon as the policy is created, independent of `allow_restart`. Destroying such a policy without `force_delete = true` will return `POLICY_HAS_OVERRIDES` (HTTP 409); see `force_delete` for guidance on when to enable it.

created_by.description: Email of the user who created the policy.

force_delete.description: When `true`, cascade-deletes any active workload override records on destroy. Has no effect on create/update. **Recommended for any policy intended for `terraform destroy`**, especially when `apply_protocol = "immediate"` or the scope is broad — without it, destroy returns `POLICY_HAS_OVERRIDES` (HTTP 409) whenever override records exist for the policy.

name.description: Unique policy name within the account.

optimization_preset.description: Optimization preset. "custom" requires an explicit guardrails block; named presets (sandbox/development/staging/production) are resolved to guardrail values server-side and exposed as Computed read-only attributes. Updates to a preset's definition do not affect existing policies.

priority.description: Policy evaluation priority. Higher value wins when multiple policies match the same workload.

tags.description: Optional client-managed tags for categorization. Each tag must be lowercase, start with a letter or digit, and contain only letters, digits, and the characters `_ - : . /`. Max 200 characters per tag; max 19 tags per policy.

updated_by.description: Email of the user who last modified the policy.

clusters.description: Required — provide via this field or `clusters_patterns`. Exact cluster names. The string `"*"` is treated literally — to match all clusters, use `clusters_patterns { include = "*" }` instead. Mutually exclusive with clusters_patterns.

namespaces.description: Required — provide via this field or `namespaces_patterns`. Exact namespace names. The string `"*"` is treated literally — to match all namespaces, use `namespaces_patterns { include = "*" }` instead. Mutually exclusive with namespaces_patterns.

resource_types.description: Workload kinds (e.g., Deployment, StatefulSet). The string `"*"` is treated literally — to match all kinds, use `resource_types_patterns { include = "*" }` instead. Mutually exclusive with resource_types_patterns.

workload_names.description: Required — provide via this field or `workload_names_patterns`. Exact workload names. The string `"*"` is treated literally — to match all workloads, use `workload_names_patterns { include = "*" }` instead. Mutually exclusive with workload_names_patterns.

exclude.description: Optional glob pattern to exclude within the include set.

block.description: Required — provide via this block or the exact `clusters` list. Glob pattern for cluster names (`include = "*"` matches all). Mutually exclusive with clusters.

body.description: Form fields merged into Klaudia `auth_params` and sent to `token_url` (same as `CustomTokenProvider` in ai-investigator).

token_url.description: Custom token endpoint (POST, form-encoded). Required when `auth.method` is `custom`.

expires_in_field.description: JSON field containing the TTL in seconds.

token_field.description: JSON field containing the access token in the exchange response.

token_type_field.description: JSON field containing the token type (e.g., `Bearer`).

env_var.description: Agent environment variable containing the token.

header_name.description: HTTP header name to send the token in.

actor_token_type.description: Actor token type URI, if actor token is required.

audience.description: Target audience for the token exchange.

client_id.description: Client ID if the token endpoint requires client authentication.

client_secret.description: Client secret if the token endpoint requires client authentication.

extra_params.description: Additional form parameters to include in the token exchange request.

file_path.description: Path to the token file on the agent pod. Mutually exclusive with `value`.

value.description: Direct token value. Mutually exclusive with `file_path`.

format.description: Header value template. Allowed placeholders: `{token_type}`, `{access_token}`. Mutually exclusive with `value`.

value.description: Literal header value. Mutually exclusive with `format`.

block.description: Headers sent to the upstream MCP server. Each entry must set exactly one of `format` (templated) or `value` (literal). Repeat the block for additional headers.

mode.description: How Klaudia reaches the MCP server. `public` — control plane calls directly. `agent-tunnel` — hub agent proxies all traffic.

provider_cluster.description: Hub cluster that holds credentials and opens the tunnel. Required when mode is `agent-tunnel`.

headers.description: Static HTTP header name → value on every MCP request (Klaudia `configuration.headers`). Merged with `auth.static_token` (same header name is overwritten by the bearer value). For dynamic auth, use with non-auth metadata only; use `auth.upstream_header` for token-backed headers.

url.description: MCP server URL. May reference an agent env var with ${VAR_NAME}.
